basic_details.scholarship_name: SOKENDAI Graduate University for Advanced Studies Fellowship
basic_details.offering_entity: SOKENDAI (The Graduate University for Advanced Studies, Hayama, Japan) & MEXT (Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: SOKENDAI in partnership with Japan's Inter-University Research Institutes: KEK (Tsukuba), NIG (Mishima), NIFS (Toki), JAXA/ISAS (Sagamihara), NAOJ (Mitaka), and IMS (Okazaki)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Doctoral research across Japan's leading national research institutes: Particle and Nuclear Physics (KEK), Materials Structure Science, Fusion Science (NIFS), Space and Astronautical Science (JAXA/ISAS), Astronomical Science (NAOJ), Genetics (National Institute of Genetics - NIG), Molecular Science (IMS), and Informatics (National Institute of Informatics - NII).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~40 to 60 prestigious MEXT University Recommendation scholarships and SOKENDAI Research Fellowships awarded annually across all research institutes
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani researchers in high-energy physics, genetics, and astronomy compete actively (typically 2 to 4 awardees/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 3 years for 3-Year Doctoral course; up to 5 years for 5-Year Integrated Doctoral course, contingent on satisfactory progress

nationality_requirements: Open to international applicants from countries holding diplomatic relations with Japan
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: For MEXT University Recommendation track, applicants must be born on or after April 2 of the eligibility birth year (typically under 35 years of age).
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for 5-Year Doctoral course; completed Master's degree (18 years education) for 3-Year Doctoral course with minimum 3.50 / 4.00 CGPA (or top 10% of class from recognized Pakistani universities like QAU, NUST, PIEAS, LUMS, UET, FAST-NUCES).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum MEXT grade point calculation formula score of 2.30 out of 3.00 required.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Advanced preparation in physics, astronomy, genetics, chemistry, molecular science, or computer science with substantial laboratory research experience.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or currently in final semester of degree graduating before arrival in Japan (April or October intake).
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Research thesis quality, conference presentations, and published papers in peer-reviewed scientific journals heavily evaluated.

english_proficiency.notes: TOEFL iBT min 80, IELTS Academic min 6.5, or official CEFR B2 level equivalent.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Japanese not required; all research, seminars, and doctoral thesis defenses are conducted in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Elite doctoral researchers in fundamental and space sciences.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot be a current recipient of another Japanese government (MEXT) scholarship.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition exemption (¥535,800/year waived) and full admission fee exemption (¥282,000 waived completely).

admission_application_fee.details: MEXT scholarship applicants are exempt from the SOKENDAI examination fee (¥30,000 waived).

accommodation.details: Paid out of living stipend; research institute international dormitories (e.g., KEK Dormitory in Tsukuba, NIG Guest House in Mishima) provide heavily subsidized housing (~¥15,000 to ¥30,000/month).

monthly_stipend.details: MEXT University Recommendation monthly stipend of ¥147,000 / month for Master's/5-year course (years 1-2) and ¥148,000 / month for Doctoral course (years 3-5; ~PKR 275,000 / month). SOKENDAI Research Fellowships provide up to ¥180,000 to ¥200,000/month (~PKR 335,000 to 375,000/mo).

airfare.details: MEXT provides round-trip international economy airfare tickets from the nearest international airport in Pakistan (Islamabad/Lahore/Karachi) to Tokyo Narita/Haneda, and return airfare upon completion.

visa_fee.details: Japanese student visa is issued free of charge for Japanese government scholarship recipients.

health_insurance.details: Japanese National Health Insurance (NHI) covers 70% of medical expenses; monthly premium is heavily subsidized for students (~¥2,000/month), paid from stipend.

food_allowance.details: Living expenses covered by monthly stipend; institute cafeterias provide subsidized meals.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Direct access to world-leading research instruments: SuperKEKB particle collider, JAXA space satellite test facilities, Subaru Telescope, and NIG genomic sequencers.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: SOKENDAI Research Grants and institute laboratory funds provide ¥200,000 to ¥500,000/year for international conference travel and research consumables.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Local transit between research institutes and Hayama headquarters is subsidized for academic courses.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Multiple national research institutes unified under SOKENDAI (The Graduate University for Advanced Studies)
participating_institutions: High Energy Accelerator Research Organization - KEK (Tsukuba, Ibaraki)
National Institute of Genetics - NIG (Mishima, Shizuoka)
National Institute for Fusion Science - NIFS (Toki, Gifu)
Institute of Space and Astronautical Science - JAXA/ISAS (Sagamihara, Kanagawa)
National Astronomical Observatory of Japan - NAOJ (Mitaka, Tokyo)
Institute for Molecular Science - IMS (Okazaki, Aichi)
National Institute of Informatics - NII (Chiyoda, Tokyo)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Japan's only national university dedicated solely to doctoral education; operates at the world frontiers of particle physics, astrophysics, and genetics.
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 3-Year Doctoral course: 3 years; 5-Year Integrated Doctoral course: 5 years.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's (5-year course) or Master's (3-year course) in physics, astronomy, genetics, or math with 3.5+ GPA, supervisor pre-agreement, research proposal, 2 recommendation letters, and English test score.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Particle Physics (KEK) and Space Science (JAXA) have intense international competition; Genetics (NIG) and Fusion Science (NIFS) offer excellent fellowship availability for candidates with strong lab backgrounds.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Prospective applicants MUST contact a potential faculty supervisor at their target research institute (KEK, JAXA, NIG, etc.) several months before the deadline. Secure their written agreement to supervise your doctoral research before submitting the formal MEXT nomination application.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: SOKENDAI International Admissions & MEXT Nomination System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Contact your prospective supervisor at the target research institute, obtain their agreement, and submit the compiled MEXT application dossier directly to the relevant SOKENDAI department office.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Identify potential faculty supervisors at participating research institutes (KEK, NIG, JAXA, NAOJ, etc.).
Step 2: Email prospective supervisor with your CV, academic transcripts, and a detailed research proposal.
Step 3: Conduct video interview with prospective supervisor and obtain their formal agreement to supervise.
Step 4: Download MEXT University Recommendation application forms from the SOKENDAI website.
Step 5: Complete MEXT Application Form, Field of Study and Research Plan (max 3 pages), and SOKENDAI forms.
Step 6: Gather 2 academic recommendation letters, official transcripts, degree certificates, and English test score.
Step 7: Submit the complete application dossier to the department office before the deadline (typically late November / early December).
Step 8: Departmental selection committee conducts interviews and nominates top candidates to SOKENDAI Academic Board.
Step 9: SOKENDAI recommends candidates to MEXT (Ministry of Education, Japan) in February; final MEXT approval in June.
Step 10: Receive official scholarship certificate, obtain free Japanese student visa, receive flight ticket, and arrive in Japan for October intake.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated nomination: SOKENDAI nominates admitted candidates directly to MEXT for the full government scholarship.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two recommendation letters: one from the Dean/Department Chair of home university and one from the academic advisor.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Field of Study and Research Plan: Detail past research accomplishments, proposed doctoral research topic, methodology, and scientific significance.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Rigorous research proposal (3-4 pages) developed in close consultation with the prospective Japanese supervisor.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing publications, conference presentations, technical skills, and honors.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Rigorous technical interview (30-45 minutes via Zoom) conducted by a 3-5 member departmental faculty panel evaluating research depth and scientific proposal.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: TOEFL iBT (80+) or IELTS Academic (6.5+). GRE General recommended for physics and math but not mandatory.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Original certified transcripts and degree certificates; verified copies required.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or Japanese translations for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Submission of physical and digital dossier to the department office.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: Late November / Early December (Strict MEXT nomination deadline for October intake)
important_dates_timeline.shortlist_announcement: February (SOKENDAI internal results) & June (Final MEXT approval)
important_dates_timeline.visa_application_window: July - August (Japanese student visa via Embassy of Japan in Islamabad)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Main international intake starts in October each year. Application dossier must be submitted by late November of the preceding year.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Undergraduate/Master's GPA and MEXT formula calculation score)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Track record of independent research, publications, and master's thesis quality)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 15% (Scientific rigor and feasibility of Field of Study and Research Plan)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 10% (Technical defense of research proposal during faculty interview)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Departmental Admissions Committee of the participating research institute and SOKENDAI Central Academic Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-stage evaluation: The participating research institute (KEK, JAXA, NIG, etc.) reviews applicant research files and conducts technical video interviews. Top-ranked candidates are recommended to the SOKENDAI Central Academic Board, which submits final nominations to MEXT for full government scholarships.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~500 to 700 elite international applicants compete across all research institutes
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~40 to 60 MEXT scholarships and SOKENDAI fellowships awarded annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~5% to 7% (Achievable for top graduates from QAU, NUST, PIEAS with strong physics/genetics research)
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 3.75+ / 4.00 CGPA (82%+ aggregate) with high thesis grades and at least 1 published paper
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates in fundamental sciences with deep theoretical knowledge, laboratory skills, and a well-matched research proposal endorsed by a Japanese professor.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates in Physics, Astronomy, Genetics, Molecular Biology, and Space Engineering.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Japan, China, Pakistan, India, South Korea, USA, Germany, Italy.

fake_websites_and_scams: Scam agencies claiming they can secure MEXT scholarships for a fee. MEXT scholarships are awarded strictly through official university nominations.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: MEXT applicants are 100% exempt from SOKENDAI examination fees. Never pay third parties.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Do not hire agents. Establishing direct academic communication with your prospective supervisor is essential.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Round-trip airfare and tuition are 100% covered by MEXT.
Initial settlement expenses before first monthly stipend disbursement (~¥50,000 - ¥80,000).
Medical examination and tuberculosis test in Pakistan (~PKR 15,000 - 25,000).
National Health Insurance monthly premium (~¥2,000/month) paid from stipend.
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: Japanese language proficiency is required. (FACT: SOKENDAI operates 100% in English for international doctoral students).
CLAIM: You can apply without a supervisor. (FACT: Applications without formal supervisor endorsement are immediately rejected).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some third-party sites report outdated stipend amounts; current MEXT doctoral stipends are ¥148,000/month.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic performance and meet annual research milestones evaluated by the supervisor.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research residency at the assigned national research institute.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reviews and doctoral dissertation interim presentations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: MEXT scholars are discouraged from part-time work, though paid research assistantships or teaching assistantships within the institute are permitted.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. International graduates from Japanese doctoral programs are eligible for the 'Designated Activities' job search visa and Japan's Highly Skilled Professional points-based visa.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship terminates if progress is unsatisfactory or if student withdraws; past disbursed funds are not clawed back.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from the academic board and supervisor.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Granted strictly for the standard 3-year (PhD) or 5-year (Integrated) duration.
